## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.  
Fix the `--exclude` default so CI can configure exclusions through `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` as project policy requires.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that skips files by basename and logs skipped paths at INFO level. It documents the flag and adds tests for parsing, matching, and archive contents.

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude` argument, `default=[]` leaves `build.log` in the archive. The CLI rule says, “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`). — CI jobs that set exclusions through the environment archive files they intended to omit.
